skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply consecutive and simultaneous interpretation techniques in professional settings.
Effectively communicate complex ideas and concepts in real-time interpretation scenarios.
Utilize basic technological tools for interpretation tasks.
Commit to lifelong learning to enhance interpretation skills in various professional contexts.
Master and apply specialized terminology in economics, management, and business.
Handle and resolve on-the-spot interpretation challenges.
Evaluate and improve the quality of interpretation work.
Work effectively in groups and lead team projects.
Adhere to professional ethics in interpretation.
Utilize technology to support interpretation tasks.
Plan and execute tasks to meet deadlines and organizational discipline.
